about_the_game: Dive into the danger with the Bandido Rush demo — a sneak peek into a high-stakes platformer where precision, reflexes, and style rule the day. Step into the boots of a daring Mexican bandido trapped in the depths of a crumbling gold mine. Armed with nothing but his six-shooter and quick wits, you'll use the recoil of your revolver to launch through the air, dodge deadly traps, and defy gravity. Test your skills, get a taste of the chaos — and prepare for the full escape ahead.
